title: Downside-only lagged realized-variance sizing for new DRA lots
thesis: An unchanged BTC DRA entry made during unusually high lagged realized variance may deserve less new capital even when the signal remains economically valid; scaling only the new lot cost down from 30 USDT may improve equal-capital total PnL and path risk without deleting the signal or changing its exit.
mechanism: At each unchanged DRA decision, divide the latest complete UTC day's sum of twenty-four squared H1 simple close-to-previous-close returns by the ordinary median of exactly the prior twenty complete-day values. Preserve the signal and next-open fill, but set the new lot cost to max(15, min(30, 30 divided by that normalized variance ratio)) USDT, rounded half-up to 1e-8. Missing warmup retains 30 USDT. Floors 10 and 20 USDT are rejection-only stability neighbors; total open cost remains at most 240 USDT, open lots at most eight, and size never exceeds 30 USDT.
economic_rationale: The byte-identical pre-economic screen passed action-level deduplication, exact source and feature coverage, signal preservation, size and theoretical-capacity bounds, intervention breadth and concentration. It found 39 Design and 30 Validation primary scaled signals, with annual interventions 17, 6, 4, 14 and 16 and top-year share 29.824561 percent. This permits one matched-capital experiment but is not performance evidence. The mechanism succeeds only if the primary improves Design and Validation fee-adjusted total PnL and risk-adjusted path metrics without hiding losses in realized, unrealized or terminal inventory, while both frozen floor neighbors remain stable.
